# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**833/5782 on GPU (14% honest, counting 944 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 4949 off: frame path 2897, during use 2044, no caller found 8; 310 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 1804 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 833/3738 on GPU (22%), 2044 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 566, event or timer 420, stored callback 319, event handler 302, observer 162, store or registry listener 152, promise 54, a method of this name is called from stored callback 24, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 24, motion handler 11, a method of this name is called from event handler 7, a method of this name is called from store or registry listener 3)**.

**Warm garbage: 155399 B/frame over 10 frame functions** (compiled, in node; `npm run warm`), all within their limits. stage frame with the vessels (stage.js + veins-gl.js, 60 Hz display, 30 Hz model) 94416 B; pressure-time chart drawn by the GPU pen (pressure-time.js + trace-gl.js, update and redraw) 17053 B; display-state: colour follows, scalar follows and the shown state, a frame of each 1022 B; label-gl: reading 30 labels (describeBlock, svgOnly, lookKey), as a sync reads those that changed 36905 B; glass-gl: the blur plan of eight glasses (blurBoxesInto), a picture 2 B; blood.advanceStream, 40 streams 2290 B; pressure-time ingest (real engine frames) 3705 B; flow-rows changedRows + retireRows + flowClose 2 B; uniform-cache, a frame of fifty uniforms 2 B; veins-bin splitCells into a kept record 2 B.
